neighbours.label: A noun naming the dimension along which something is measured or graded (scale, duration, intensity, severity, efficacy, experience level), after a quantifier or modifier; quiet when the same nouns name concrete objects.
fire: The atlas shows land use at regional and national scales for each province.
Each workshop is of three days duration and ends with a short project.
The drill is suitable for builders of every experience level.
Interval training alternates bursts of high intensity with short rests.
Early results suggest a booster with 85% efficacy against hospital admission.
Flood risk maps are produced at several spatial scales for city planners.
The postgraduate diploma is of one year duration and is taught in English.
Choose a jog of low intensity on the days between strength sessions.
quiet: She weighed the flour on the kitchen scales before mixing the dough.
The lizard shed its old scales on a warm rock by the wall.
He practised piano scales for an hour before dinner.
The parking garage has four levels and an exit on each side.
They bought a sack of potatoes and a box of eggs at the farm.
The river rose after the storm and covered the lower road.
The child drew a dragon with green wings and a red tail.
The nurse checked the bandage and changed the dressing.

predictions: median fire ~0.55 (probes: several scales 0.77, months duration 0.57, moderate intensity 0.50, all experience levels 0.59, 90% efficacy 0.74, severity 0.21); near misses < 0.03 (bathroom scales 0.013, fish scales 0.012, bread 0.026).
notes: A verb-style label: the shared role is 'the axis of measurement', not the list of nouns. 'Severity' was weakest (0.21).
